description: The line plot illustrates the massive activation of the attention output gate, representing the maximum activation values across different model layers for four distinct network components. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and follows a linear scale with a data range from 0 to 23, featuring regularly spaced numeric tick labels at intervals of 5 from 0 to 20. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 50. There are four lines in the plot, all without markers. The "attn_output" line is blue and dashed; it starts near 0 at layer 0, remains relatively flat and low with minor fluctuations up to approximately 30 at layer 20, and then sharply increases to about 110 at layer 23. The "attn_residual" line is orange and dotted; it begins near 0 at layer 0, gradually rises to roughly 140 at layer 21, and ends with a sharp upward trend reaching approximately 260 at layer 23. The "ffn_output" line is green and dash-dotted; it remains relatively steady near 0 from layer 0 to layer 21, rises to roughly 45 at layer 22, and spikes to about 160 at layer 23. Finally, the "ffn_residual" line is solid red; it starts near 0 at layer 0, exhibits a steady upward trend to approximately 140 at layer 21, climbs to 180 at layer 22, and peaks sharply at roughly 385 at the final data point of layer 23.
